post.description:
Begin linking Google or GitHub to a signed-in account that has a password.

The proof is checked first (the password and a two-step code when two-step is on), so a stolen token cannot
attach someone else's provider account. The reply holds the address to send the browser to. It also sets the
OAuth state cookie and a signed cookie that names this account and this session, which the callback requires.
Microsoft is not offered, because a Microsoft address is not verified and never links by email.

Accept a new (boot, seq) counter for a machine whose flash was wiped.

A machine that sends the pair must always send a newer one. A hub whose flash was erased starts its boot count again at 1
and would be refused for ever. This forgets the last pair so the next post sets the new start. The machine still has to
send the pair. Admin only and audited.

The people who may resolve the alert may give it (an admin or a technician on a machine they may change), with a
session or an operate token. Only a model alert confirmed as a real fault keeps its readings out of the model's
training. An unconfirmed one does not, so a machine whose normal changed is retrained on it and its alert can clear.

post.description:
Let the next retrain move this machine's normal past the bound and re-anchor it there. Admin only, with fresh proof.

A retrain refuses a model that would move a machine's normal further than the bound from the model in service or from
the first model accepted for it, because a slow walk is what a drifting fault or a forged sensor looks like. A person
who knows the change is real (a new product, a season, a repair) accepts it here and then retrains.

put.description:
Set (or clear with null) the node whose air temperature is this machine's ambient reference. Admin only.

The source must be another machine the caller may read and should stand in the same place. The next retrain models
this machine's temperatures as their rise above that reading, so a warmer room is not read as a warmer machine.

route) and its own model is used. An id that is not a machine scores with the node type's and the general models.

stop when the person who set it up leaves. Its tokens are made with `POST /tokens` and an `account_id`, by an admin with
fresh proof. It has no password, provider link, two-step, session, invitation or reset link and the sign-in route answers
for it exactly as for an unknown address.

post.description:
Up to 100 readings from one device in one request, oldest first, with a result for each in order.

Auth is the device key, as for a single post. The envelope answers 200 whenever the request itself is acceptable and every
reading's own answer is in `results` (status stored, duplicate or refused and for a refusal the code, sentence and the status
a single post would have answered). The wire contract of POST /api/v1/telemetry does not change.
